subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Given the fact that most of us _________ over 90% of our time indoors, it is most important to _______ that the air we breathe in at home or in offices can be _______. It can be a ______ of illhealth.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4** i.e. **spend; recognise; polluted; cause.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given the fact that most of us **spend** over 90% of our time indoors, it is most important to **recognise** that the air we breathe in at home or in offices can be **polluted**.
 
• It highlights the importance of acknowledging the potential contamination of indoor air, which can be a **cause** of ill health.
 
• The sentence structure and context clearly indicate that acknowledging the quality of indoor air and its effects on health is crucial.
 
• Choosing terms like **"spend"** for time, **"recognise"** for the action of acknowledging, **"polluted"** for the state of air, and **"cause"** for the relationship to ill health fit the context accurately.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **Option 4: spend; recognise; polluted; cause.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Understanding the significance of indoor air quality is essential for maintaining good health, especially considering the substantial amount of time spent indoors.
 
• Polluted indoor air can contain a variety of contaminants, including dust, mold, and chemicals, which can contribute to respiratory problems, allergies, and other health issues.
 
• Recognising and addressing indoor air pollution can lead to better health outcomes and improve overall well-being.
